text: Visitors have reported confusion and frustration around the timed ticketing system, with some arriving without knowing tickets must be ordered in advance and encountering no clear signage or information at nearby visitor centers. Several reviews mention difficulty finding the library, including navigation errors that led people to incorrect locations. There are also concerns about the lack of representation of local North Dakota artists in the gift shop and exhibits, with some criticism of the use of AI-generated content. A few visitors expressed dissatisfaction with customer service, particularly regarding ticket changes and limited staff assistance. Positive comments focus on the building’s architecture, views of the surrounding landscape, and interactive exhibits.
